subject.title: fix(imessage): prevent missed messages after gateway crashes

question: Should this iMessage durable-ingress migration land only after the merged-adoption loop is made fault-isolating and a real crash/restart replay is shown?
rationale: The remaining defect is mechanically repairable, but the PR changes message-delivery persistence and carries the protected `maintainer` label, so a maintainer should confirm the resulting delivery and settlement contract before merge.

options.title: Repair and prove before merge
options.body: Settle every constituent lifecycle even when one callback fails, add a regression test, and attach redacted crash/restart evidence showing the queued row is replayed once.

options.title: Accept deferred recovery
options.body: Land with the current callback behavior and accept that a transient adoption callback failure may defer sibling claims until timeout or restart.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Keep the per-channel durable-ingress rollout open while the iMessage adapter contract is reconsidered.

recommendation.title: Repair and prove before merge
recommendation.body: Settle every constituent lifecycle even when one callback fails, add a regression test, and attach redacted crash/restart evidence showing the queued row is replayed once.

likelyOwner.reason: The implementation series and assignment in the supplied PR context connect this contributor most directly to the affected adapter.
